scored_by: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via scripts/rubric.mjs, two independent passes per asset (pass A on the 8x plain view, pass B on the debug sheet), re-scored after the Phase 6 art changes

verdict.note: Re-score after the Phase 6 art changes. Mean 3.73 against a 4.0 bar, with scene pass A scoring lighting 2 — the bar is missed, so the track records the failure rather than lowering it. Humanoid pass A rose from lighting 2 to 3 with round form bands.

silhouette.why: The distinct shape of a corked bottle with a bulbous base is immediately clear at 1x scale without color.

value_separation.why: The liquid, glass, and cork parts are mostly distinct, though some neighboring values blend slightly along the interior lines.

lighting.why: The light source generally comes from the top right, but the shading on the liquid and cork is somewhat flattened and inconsistent.

edge_language.why: The dark outline is consistently maintained around the silhouette, but inner details lack a clear, varied treatment.

cluster_discipline.why: Pixels are generally well-grouped into clean shapes, with only minor isolated placement near highlights.

palette_craft.why: The color palette is coherent and fits a potion theme, but the ramps could transition more smoothly across values.
